en.title: Iron Husk Voyage: Echoes of Silence Tearing the Azure Sky
en.premise: After entrusting Luna to the final train, Kyle awoke with no memory, swinging his sword amidst the ruins of a dead world. But the world had not rebooted; instead, it had devolved into the 'Age of Turbidity,' where a torrent of memories blurred the boundary between sky and sea. Between new powers wielding airships and the relics of an old world slumbering beneath the waves, Kyle casts himself back into the fray. With a will of iron, he begins his quest to reclaim his lost identity and find where Luna has gone.

zh.title: 骸铁之航路：撕裂苍穹的沉默残响
zh.premise: 将露娜托付给最终列车后，失去记忆的凯尔在废墟中不断挥剑。然而，世界并非重启，而是在记忆的奔流中，演变成了天空与海洋交织的“混浊时代”。操纵飞空船的新势力，以及沉睡在海底的旧世界遗物。为了寻找失去的自我以及露娜的下落，凯尔再次怀揣钢铁般的意志，投身于战场之中。
